evidence_slice: Lewisham Council's official Local Plan Inspectors Report (June 2025) examines Policy LCA SA8 for 100-114 Loampit Vale. The inspectors record mixed-use redevelopment of around 30 dwellings, 298 square metres of employment space and 596 square metres of main town-centre uses. They state that the previous planning permission has lapsed, there is no current planning permission, the landowner has expressed an interest in developing the site, and the site is expected to come forward in years 6-10; with the identified modifications, the allocation is justified and developable within the plan period. Lewisham's official Central Area chapter identifies this as site allocation number 8.
